subject.title: Renderer placeholder leak: `(see attached image)`, `Image reply`, `Audio reply`, `Media reply` leak to human-visible Telegram reply under specific content-classification paths

question: Should a Telegram owner sponsor an instrumented current-main reproduction before this issue is routed for implementation?
rationale: The report identifies real literals but not the owner-boundary crossing, and the repository currently marks the issue to avoid a speculative new fix PR.

options.title: Sponsor outbound trace
options.body: Capture a current-main Telegram run from shared reply payload through the final redacted Bot API request and use the first incorrect boundary to scope the fix.

options.title: Request reporter artifacts
options.body: Ask for a current-version session excerpt, gateway logs, screenshot or recording, and the triggering input before scheduling repository work.
